name: Online pharmacy: launch plan and first-year costs
about: Launching a US online pharmacy that ships over-the-counter products and fills prescriptions by mail from a licensed pharmacy facility: licenses in every state it ships to, digital pharmacy accreditation, HIPAA compliance, a pharmacy management system with e-prescribing, cold-chain shipping, and advertising certification. Assumes no controlled substances at launch and 10 states in the first year. Regulation varies by state and country - check with a pharmacy lawyer before acting on this plan. Four phases: Analysis, Implementation, a 3-month launch period with a bigger launch promotion and higher costs, and operation for months 4-12. Staff: a pharmacist-in-charge and a pharmacy technician, about $17,000 a month with payroll taxes. days = the owner's or team's project work in man-days (the editor turns it into labor cost as days x rate); capex = fixed assets bought (equipment, furniture, hardware); opex = operating outlays (rent, wages, stock, platform fees, marketing). Costs only: no revenue, and no ongoing stock reorders, payment fees or shipping costs, since they depend on sales.
